description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage B2B SaaS company as its first infrastructure hire, owning the platform foundations behind an agentic integration product. You will work closely with the founding team, build the core infrastructure function, and grow toward leading the team as it expands.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and operate a runtime platform with durable execution, sandboxed isolation, and self-healing capabilities.

 - Develop infrastructure for coding agents that write, test, and deploy integration code in production.

 - Design observability across integrations and agents, including logs, metrics, and tracing.

 - Build and maintain a single-tenant, self-hostable product deployment.

 - Set engineering patterns for future infrastructure hires, help grow the team, and ship production improvements continuously.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Three to nine years of professional software engineering experience, including at least three years in fast-moving, ambiguous startup environments.

 - A software engineering, computer science, or quantitative degree completed or in progress, with strong technical fundamentals.

 - Experience with software engineering and cloud infrastructure, including hands-on ownership of cloud infrastructure or a platform end to end.

 - Production experience operating, scaling, and debugging Kubernetes, with experience using AWS and Docker.

 - Experience building production observability across logs, metrics, and tracing, and sound judgment using AI coding agents.

 - Background as a funded startup founder or as an engineer at an early-stage, venture-backed startup. Experience with self-hosted, single-tenant deployments is valuable.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $175,000 to $300,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available, including realistic O-1 sponsorship.


LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco, California, United States. Candidates currently elsewhere in the United States should have a concrete, dated relocation plan to San Francisco.
